description: C23 standard verification test suite with feature smoke tests. Creates comprehensive test program to validate C23-specific features like [[nodiscard]] messages, typeof improvements, and enhanced static_assert. Must gracefully degrade on non-C23 compilers.
steps: Create test/test_c23_features.c with C23 feature detection and validation
Add enhanced static_assert with custom messages test
Add typeof/auto type deduction validation in error propagation macros
Add binary literals and digit separators validation test
Add compiler version detection and graceful degradation logic
Update Makefile with test-c23-features target that compiles and runs the new test
Update .github/workflows/ci.yml to run C23 feature tests when GCC 13+ available
acceptance_criteria: Test gracefully skips unsupported features on older compilers
All C23 features used in nur.h are validated
make test-c23-features passes on systems with C23 support
CI workflow runs C23 tests when compiler supports it
verification: ./test_c23 and verify all feature tests pass
make test-c23-features validates integration with build system
findings:
✅ FEAT-001 COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY

1. **test/test_c23_features.c** - Comprehensive C23 feature validation test suite (715 lines)

   - typeof/__auto_type deduction in error propagation
   - Binary literals and digit separators support
   - Compiler version detection and graceful degradation
   - Integration testing with nur.h core functionality

2. **Makefile Updates** - Added test-c23-features target
   - C23_TEST_SRC and C23_TEST_BINARY variables
   - test-c23-features target with proper error handling
   - Updated clean and help targets

3. **.github/workflows/ci.yml Updates** - C23 CI integration
   - Added C23 feature test step for GCC 13+

- **Feature Detection**: Robust C23/C17/C11/C99 detection with fallbacks
- **Attribute Support**: Tests [[nodiscard("msg")]] vs __attribute__ vs _Check_return_

- Return codes: 1=pass, 0=fail, -1=skip (C23 N/A)

- Proper macro hygiene with volatile variables
- nur.h standards-compliant error handling patterns
